test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECT section of the given sentence.

Four people / were / witnesses of / that event.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the phrase "**witnesses of**" instead of the correct phrase "**witnesses to**."
 
• The correct preposition to use with "witnesses" in this context is "to" and not "of".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**witnesses to that event**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Four people were witnesses to that event."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Four people** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **were** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **that event.** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
